note: Tested clean-room procedural-mesh, transform, modifier-stack, and Qt desktop-workflow subsets. FUNCTIONAL entries are not claims of complete 3ds Max parity, animation, rendering, or production-scene interoperability.

capabilities.name: Procedural box and mesh evaluation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Generate 3D parametric boxes with length, width, height, and verified boundary surface area.
capabilities.expected_output: Evaluated mesh topology and correct surface area

capabilities.name: Procedural cylinder with radial segments
capabilities.reference_behavior: Generate parametric cylinders with specified radius, height, and side segment count.
capabilities.expected_output: Dual cap and side quad mesh geometry

capabilities.name: Bend modifier deformation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Apply non-destructive angular bending along an object axis.
capabilities.differences: Circular arc axis bend deformation verified.

capabilities.name: Taper modifier deformation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Scale object cross-section along an axis with optional curvature.

capabilities.name: Twist modifier deformation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Rotate vertices progressively around the central axis.
capabilities.expected_output: Rotated vertex positions preserving mesh integrity

capabilities.name: TurboSmooth mesh subdivision
capabilities.reference_behavior: Subdivide polygon faces into quad/triangle children to smooth geometry.
capabilities.expected_output: Refined mesh with 4x face count per iteration
capabilities.differences: One through four midpoint-subdivision iterations are evaluated deterministically. This is not Catmull-Clark subdivision and does not yet share edge vertices or preserve crease weights.

capabilities.name: Wavefront OBJ geometry export
capabilities.reference_behavior: Export evaluated 3D mesh geometry to standard Wavefront OBJ files.
capabilities.expected_output: Formatted Wavefront OBJ with vertices and face indices

capabilities.name: Native project serialization and round-trip
capabilities.reference_behavior: Save and reopen .mystudio files preserving primitive definitions and modifier stacks.
capabilities.differences: Schema-v3 structural JSON preserves supported objects, object transforms, stack order and state, parameters, materials, and stable ID allocation; validates temporary saves and retains backups. Schema-v1 and schema-v2 migration are supported. Unknown future schemas are rejected. Hierarchy, animation, textures, plugins, and unknown extension data are not yet supported.

capabilities.name: Non-destructive modifier stack editing with undo and redo
capabilities.command: MODIFIER / MOVE / REMOVE / SET / UNDO / REDO
capabilities.reference_behavior: Edit modifier parameters, enabled state and order non-destructively, regenerate evaluated geometry, and restore edits through undo/redo.
capabilities.expected_input: Primitive with ordered taper and twist modifiers
capabilities.expected_output: Order and parameter changes regenerate the mesh; undo/redo restores stack state and evaluated geometry
capabilities.performance: Full selected-object regeneration after each edit
capabilities.differences: Tested for Bend, Taper, Twist, and midpoint subdivision stacks, including Qt command-panel creation and undo/redo in the separate UI regression test. Instancing, stack collapse, sub-object selections, world-space modifiers, and dependency graphs remain unsupported.

capabilities.name: Editable object transforms
capabilities.reference_behavior: Apply persistent translation, XYZ rotation, and non-zero per-axis scaling to evaluated scene objects.
capabilities.expected_input: Finite translation and rotation values with non-zero scale components
capabilities.expected_output: Transformed evaluated mesh restored by undo/redo and native file round-trip
capabilities.performance: Full selected-object regeneration after each committed transform
capabilities.differences: Numerical transform evaluation and persistence are tested. Interactive gizmos, transform coordinate systems, pivot editing, constraints, snapping, and transform animation remain unsupported.

capabilities.name: Persistent Qt modeling workspace
capabilities.command: SCENE EXPLORER / CREATE / MODIFY / MODIFIER STACK / SAVE / OPEN / EXPORT
capabilities.reference_behavior: Provide an interactive desktop scene editor connected to the editable model, evaluated viewport, hierarchy browser, property controls, modifier stack, file persistence, and undo/redo.
capabilities.expected_input: Mouse and keyboard modeling operations in the standalone Qt application
capabilities.expected_output: Document mutations reflected in the scene explorer, modifier stack, properties, and shaded mesh viewport
capabilities.performance: Immediate redraw for the tested procedural scenes
capabilities.differences: The offscreen test verifies primitive creation, transform editing, modifier insertion, scene-tree synchronization, and undo/redo. The viewport uses a CPU orthographic orbit projection and does not yet provide GPU rendering, transform gizmos, sub-object editing, hierarchy tools, animation, materials, or production rendering.
